notablePrerequisites:
Rapacious One does not have summoning sickness.
Rapacious One can not be blocked.
description:
Declare Rapacious One as an attacker.
When Rapacious One deals combat damage, it triggers, creating at least five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by sacrificing five Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.
